title: THE OVERSEER RAMPAGE ENDS WHEN THE OVERSEER IS ALREADY DEAD
why: Cloud robustness hunt. The rampage start does nothing when the Overseer is dead by the end of the 12 second warning, so it never marks the boss as rampaging, and the tick then returned on that missing mark before its own dead-boss test, so the event never ended early. Proven in headless Chromium on v27.27 (CAREER, seed 1): rampage launched, Overseer killed during the warning, the event stayed live 137 more seconds with its ring and OVERSEER RAMPAGE on screen, and while it was live no other raid event could launch. Now the tick tests for a dead or removed Overseer first, so the event ends at once. A live rampage is unchanged.
now: The Overseer rampage ends at once if the Overseer is killed during its warning, instead of a ring hanging on for two minutes.
